title: Heritage Monuments of India
description: How well do you know India's most famous landmarks?

questions.q: The Taj Mahal was built by which Mughal emperor?
questions.fact: Shah Jahan built the Taj Mahal (c. 1631–1653) in memory of his wife Mumtaz Mahal.

questions.q: In which city is the Golden Temple located?
questions.fact: The Golden Temple (Harmandir Sahib) is in Amritsar, the spiritual centre of Sikhism.

questions.q: The Qutub Minar is made primarily of which material?
questions.fact: The Qutub Minar is built mainly of red sandstone with marble in its upper storeys.

questions.q: Which ancient university's ruins are a UNESCO site in Bihar?
questions.fact: Nalanda Mahavihara taught up to 10,000 students before its destruction around 1200 CE.

questions.q: Humayun's Tomb is said to have inspired which later monument?
questions.fact: Humayun's Tomb (1572) was the first grand Mughal garden-tomb and a template for the Taj Mahal.

title: Festivals of India
description: Test your knowledge of India's vibrant festivals.

questions.q: Chhath Puja is dedicated to which deity?
questions.fact: Chhath Puja worships the Sun God (Surya) and Chhathi Maiya; it is Bihar's most important festival.

questions.q: Baisakhi marks the founding of the Khalsa and is celebrated mainly in?
questions.fact: Baisakhi is Punjab's harvest festival and the Sikh new year, commemorating the Khalsa founded in 1699.

questions.q: 'Dev Deepawali', when ghats are lit with countless lamps, is celebrated in?
questions.fact: Dev Deepawali lights up the ghats of Varanasi about fifteen days after Diwali.

questions.q: The Pushkar Fair in Rajasthan is best known for trading which animal?
questions.fact: The Pushkar Camel Fair is one of the world's largest camel and livestock fairs.

title: Traditional Crafts & Textiles
description: From embroidery to pottery — how well do you know Indian crafts?

questions.q: Phulkari embroidery originates from which state?
questions.fact: Phulkari ('flower work') is the traditional silk-floss embroidery of Punjab.

questions.q: Madhubani painting is also known as?
questions.fact: Madhubani is also called Mithila painting, after the Mithila region of Bihar.

questions.q: Jaipur blue pottery is unusual because it contains no?
questions.fact: Blue pottery is made from quartz, glass and borax — it contains no clay.

questions.q: Chikankari, the delicate white shadow-work embroidery, is from?
questions.fact: Chikankari is the signature hand embroidery of Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh.
